findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md:99 says `grill_get` can be read across all phases, but the phase-aware tool inventory at docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md:121 does not list `grill_get` under 全阶段可用. WHY: code exposes `grill_get` globally in packages/main/src/core/config.ts:122, so the doc now contradicts its own tool map and can mislead readers about whether read-only grill access is allowed outside PLAN. Fix: add `grill_get` to the 全阶段可用 table or explicitly split PLAN-only mutating grill commands from globally available read access.

packages/main/src/core/store.ts:262 WHY: readGrill catches every read/parse failure and returns null. packages/main/src/handlers/grill.ts:53,90,132 then treat null as "no artifact" and initialize empty grill state, so a malformed grill.json is silently hidden and can be overwritten by the next PLAN mutation. Fix: return null only for file-not-found probe cases; report or rethrow parse/read failures so corruption does not erase planning context.

.koala/story/actives/B-d9ee/checklist.json:67 WHY: every checklist verificationEvidence entry still records headHash 478fe90bbafffe2759e942f3b368da11026b6de9, and .koala/story/actives/B-d9ee/test-evidence.json:6 records the last koala validate PASS against the same old head. Commit ae1ba6a0 was the evidence-refresh commit, so this reviewer lane cannot accept the claim that evidence is fresh after ae1ba6a0 until the referenced test/validate artifacts are rerun or refreshed to that commit (or a newer code-bearing head with matching evidence). Malformed grill artifact regression coverage and artifact/evidence separation are present, but freshness remains stale.
